text:
elaine_cs: Heads-up — Oncella (pilot) requested a header-based ingress whitelist for their Canada AZ + a short-term rate limit increase for customer-facing demos this week. Renewal risk: they're trialing and low usage so demo perf is critical. Can ops provision this?

onboard-bot: Onboarding summary — Oncella started 2026-03-18. Seats: 2 engineers. Trial credits remaining: 1,200 units. Demos scheduled: Thu 10:00 ET (public demo), Fri 14:00 ET (internal).

raj_ops: Need exact header keys + any IPs/CIDRs. Also how long do they want the RL increase? We should scope blast radius.

elaine_cs: They use a partner LB that injects headers; keys they rely on: `X-Org-ID` and `X-Partner-Token`. They prefer header auth instead of IP only because they push through a regional CDN. Requested RL increase: demo window + 48h buffer (approx 72h total).

elaine_cs: Proposed allowlist payload for infra (we can restrict to Canada AZ ingress path):
```json
{
  "customer": "oncella",
  "region": "ca-central-1",
  "ingress_filter": {
    "headers": ["X-Org-ID", "X-Partner-Token"],
    "header_value_regex": "^oncella-.*$",
    "source_cidrs": ["35.182.0.0/16", "34.68.0.0/14"]
  },
  "temp_rate_increase": {
    "scope": "route:demo-api",
    "multiplier": 3,
    "duration_seconds": 259200
  }
}
```

mike_infra: Security check — header-based allowlisting is fine but needs a short PR + review. We'll open INF-3032 and run a smoke in staging. I can apply a staged ingress filter and a token enforcement flag. We'll also add a trace tag for demo traffic.

chloe_pm: Capture this as feedback — they reported latency spikes for long conversational sessions (context size > 16k). If demos show degradation that's a risk to renewal. We should log this to Product feedback and signal Optimize to propose quantization/kvcache tweaks.

raj_ops: Created INF-3032, assigned to @mike_infra. Staging change scheduled in 30m, smoke for 15m after deploy. Will push to prod once smoke passes.

elaine_cs: Thanks — I'll update the customer and schedule the enablement runbook for Thu 9am ET so they can rehearse before demo. Also adding renewal flag to the account: low-utilization — escalation if post-demo adoption stays < 2 calls/min.

mike_infra: Apply plan: staging ingress filter + header enforcement; temp RL multiplier 3 on `route:demo-api` for 72h; add trace tag `oncella-demo-03`. Will post logs and perf snapshots to CS ticket CS-8421. :white_check_mark:

elaine_cs: Perfect. Please ping in this thread when prod is live and share any rollback steps.

raj_ops: Prod change complete, smoke looks good. Tagging: 1769994861.
